In [[geometric topology]], a branch of mathematics, the '''Bing shrinking criterion''', introduced by {{harvtxt|Bing|1952}}, is a method for showing that a [[Quotient space (topology)|quotient]] of a space is [[homeomorphism|homeomorphic]] to the space.
